international.summary: "She fought until she couldn’t anymore," the Cincinnati Zoo said in a statement. Fiona became ill a few days after the incident.

international.title: Fiona the hippo dies after ingesting knitted hat at Cincinnati zoo
international.summary: Zoo staff tried a colonoscopy, vibration plate and other procedures to aid the hippo in passing the hat to no avail Fiona the hippo, one of America’s most famous zoo animals, has died after efforts to remove a knitted hat that she swallowed after it fell into her enclosure proved unsuccessful. With surgery too risky for a full-grown hippos like Fiona, who weighed in the region of 2,500lb (1,113kg), veterinarians tried alternative method of getting the hat to pass through her system.
